audit.whatIsWrong: EVEN / 5.5-6 is consistent with 52.15% over 163 games; the lane is decided by Tangle-Barbs.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s at 1000 range and roots longer once it has passed through a champion — it out-ranges your 900 Pillar and is her only setup.
audit.corrected: Ratings untouched; cooldown and don't fields re-grounded in that timer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and late text described Pop Blossom as a 'decoy-based ultimate' and a 'clone trick'.
audit.why: Pop Blossom is a 600-range leap that knocks up and then stuns on landing; the clone is Shapesplitter (W, 16/15/14/13/12s). The genuine spike fact is that its preparation is hidden while she is disguised.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid and breakdown.carry rewritten onto the real ultimate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neeko was credited with a 'passive shield', and the decisive disguise interaction was never stated.
audit.why: Inherent Glamour is a disguise with no defensive value, and Riot's own text says it breaks on receiving immobilizing crowd control — Sear's stun ends it outright. It also breaks when the disguise takes damage equal to its health bar, which is what a Pillar of Flame over the wave does.
audit.corrected: whys[2], early, spikes[0].text, dosFull[1].d, wants.you[0] rewritten around it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; packet also flags zero sequencing cues anywhere on this matchup.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs 12s->10s, Pop Blossom 120/105/90s, Pyroclasm 100s give real 'wait for X before Y' lines.
audit.corrected: cooldowns, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[2].d now carry the numbers and the order of operations.
